Review Skala?

Reviewers describe Skala as a clean, practical service that removes a lot of early startup legal friction. The strongest firsthand feedback says incorporation in Delaware happened within days, with quick help on a corporate bank account and unusually hands-on support from the founder and team. Others, though less specific, see it as a real time and money saver for founders dealing with legal paperwork. The only recurring gaps are requests for broader geographic coverage, such as EU incorporations, and questions about how often the service will be updated as laws change.
